georgiacivicdata: Access Public Data from 'Georgia Civic Data'

Source: R/georgiacivicdata-package.R
georgiacivicdata-package.Rd

An R client for the Georgia Civic Data REST API at https://georgiacivicdata.org/api/v1 (documentation: https://georgiacivicdata.org/docs): cleaned public data about Georgia's schools and communities, as tidy tibbles with place names beside codes, typed from each dataset's schema.

Functions

Find data

  • gcd_datasets(): the catalog, one row per dataset.

  • gcd_search(): ranked dataset search from plain words.

Understand a dataset

  • gcd_describe(): everything about one dataset or lookup table.

  • gcd_columns(): the column dictionary as a table.

  • gcd_contract(): the formal ODCS data contract.

Get data

  • gcd_rows(): filtered rows, with names beside codes.

  • gcd_values(): which category combinations exist, with row counts.

Lookup tables

  • gcd_dimension(): districts, schools, counties, tracts, block groups and demographic groups, with their attributes.

Geography and school zones

  • gcd_school_zones(): attendance-zone polygons.

  • gcd_district_boundaries(): school district outlines.

  • gcd_school_zone_status(): whether each school has a zone.

  • gcd_school_zone_coverage(): how completely each district's zones were collected.

  • gcd_locate(): the county, tract, block group, district and zoned schools for points or street addresses.

Utilities

  • gcd_meta() and gcd_citation(): the metadata and citation that travel with results.

  • gcd_cache_clear(): empty the session and disk caches.

Missing values

A missing metric (NA) usually means the value was suppressed to protect privacy (small counts), not that it is zero. Each dataset's schema says which (gcd_describe()), and gcd_rows() prints the API's advisory when a result holds suppressed values.

Data license

The data is published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit "Georgia Civic Data (georgiacivicdata.org)" and the original source; gcd_citation() writes the citation. The package code is MIT-licensed.

Options

  • gcd.quiet: TRUE silences the advisory messages of gcd_rows() and the notes of the zone functions for the session.

  • gcd.cache: TRUE turns on the disk cache of gcd_rows() for the session.
